# Harsh-Environment Mass Spectrometry Society (HEMS)
> Official website of the Harsh-Environment Mass Spectrometry Society, Inc. (IRS 501(c)(3) scientific public charity, founded 1999) — biennial international symposium and 25+ year open-access proceedings archive for portable, subsea, planetary, atmospheric, and field-deployable mass spectrometry.

## Primary Public Pages
- [Home](https://www.hems-workshop.org/): Overview of the HEMS Society, technical charter, field mass spectrometry domains, and upcoming symposium highlights.
- [16th HEMS Workshop Hub — September 2027](https://www.hems-workshop.org/layout-portal/): Save-the-date announcements, milestones, and central portal for the 16th Biennial HEMS Workshop (September 2027).
- [About the HEMS Society](https://www.hems-workshop.org/about/): Official 501(c)(3) mission statement, volunteer governance, and five core strategic objectives.
- [Workshop & Society History (1999–2025)](https://www.hems-workshop.org/history/): Complete historical chronicle from the 1999 USF Center for Ocean Technology workshop through NASA JPL miniature vacuum collaborations and global coastal symposia.
- [Open-Access Proceedings Archive](https://www.hems-workshop.org/archive/): Searchable 15-workshop digital repository (1,590 PDF slide decks, extended abstracts, posters, and programs) with scientific synonym expansion.
- [Student Travel Awards](https://www.hems-workshop.org/student-awards/): $1,500.00 graduate student travel grant guidelines, M.S./M.A./Ph.D. eligibility, required application items, and selection criteria.
- [Call for Papers](https://www.hems-workshop.org/call-for-papers/): Abstract submission instructions, technical focus areas, and symposium deadlines.
- [Formatting Guidelines](https://www.hems-workshop.org/formatting-guidelines/): Single-page PDF abstract layout specifications, typography, and file naming conventions.
- [Workshop Registration](https://www.hems-workshop.org/registration/): Professional, student, and corporate attendee registration tiers and policies.
- [Venue & Accommodations](https://www.hems-workshop.org/accommodations/): Host beachfront hotel details and group room-block information.
- [Corporate Sponsorship](https://www.hems-workshop.org/corporate-sponsorship/): Evergreen 501(c)(3) corporate partnership benefits, tabletop hardware exhibition details, split-invoicing options, and historical registry of 52 industry sponsors.
- [Contact the Committee](https://www.hems-workshop.org/contact/): Direct channels for general society inquiries (`info@hems-workshop.org`), Student Travel Awards (`hemsworkshop@hems-workshop.org`), and Corporate Sponsorship coordination.

## Machine-Readable Proceedings Index
For scholarly search engines, bibliometric indexers, and AI research assistants, a flat JSON catalog of all archived oral presentations, posters, authors, affiliations, and PDF URLs is published at:
- [Proceedings JSON Index](https://www.hems-workshop.org/archives-index.json)
- [XML Sitemap](https://www.hems-workshop.org/sitemap.xml)

## Core Scientific & Engineering Domains
Portable mass spectrometers, miniaturized mass analyzers, rectilinear and cylindrical ion traps, time-of-flight MS (TOF-MS), cycloidal and magnetic sector analyzers, Orbitrap spaceflight concepts, membrane inlet mass spectrometry (MIMS), miniature turbomolecular and diaphragm vacuum pumps, planetary exploration (Mars, Titan Dragonfly DraMS, Europa, lunar volatiles), autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) and deep-sea hydrothermal vent sensing, volcanic plume UAV sampling, CBRNE defense and homeland security trace detection, environmental VOC monitoring, and harsh-environment industrial process control.
